description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את תנאי הפוליסה לביטוח רכוש, ספציפית עבור אספני אמנות. הפוליסה מגדירה כיצד יחושב סכום הפיצוי במקרה של אובדן או נזק לפריטים, תוך התייחסות לפריטים בודדים, זוגות/סטים, ונזק חלקי. סכום הפיצוי יתבסס על הערך המוסכם המופיע בתוספת הפוליסה או על שווי השוק לפני האובדן. במקרה של אובדן חלקי, הפיצוי יכסה את עלות התיקון ופחת, אך לא יעלה על הערך המלא של הפריט. פריטים, זוגות וסטים, ערך מוסכם, נזק חלקי, שווי שוק.

10.3  Pairs and Sets In event of loss or damage to any item or items having a special or increased value by virtue of forming part of a pair or set, this insurance shall not take account of any such special or increased value, but shall only pay a proportionate part of the insured value of such pair or set.
Nevertheless in no event will the Insurer be liable for more than the applicable limits of liability set out in the Schedule.
In the event of partial loss of or damage to any item insured the amount payable will be the cost and expense of restoration plus any resulting depreciation but not exceeding the full value of that item, valued as in the schedule.
Following payment of the full amount insured for any item, pair or set, the Insurer will become the full owners and reserve the right to take possession of the item, pair or set.

טבלה: תנאי פוליסת ביטוח רכוש - אמנות
This table outlines conditions related to loss, damage, and valuation for a Fine Art Collector's Insurance policy. It details how the insurer determines payable amounts for individual items, pairs/sets, and partial losses.
ממדים: Conditions related to loss/damage scenarios, Details of valuation and insurer's rights

10.3  Pairs and Sets In event of loss or damage to any item or items having a special or increased value by virtue of forming part of a pair or set, this insurance shall not take account of any such special or increased value, but shall only pay a proportionate part of the insured value of such pair or set.
Nevertheless in no event will the Insurer be liable for more than the applicable limits of liability set out in the Schedule.
In the event of partial loss of or damage to any item insured the amount payable will be the cost and expense of restoration plus any resulting depreciation but not exceeding the full value of that item, valued as in the schedule.
Following payment of the full amount insured for any item, pair or set, the Insurer will become the full owners and reserve the right to take possession of the item, pair or set.
